Subject: SUP-03 / SI-PM-0003 — supporting evidence requested

Hello Hammer Industries team,

For part SI-PM-0003 (Rack power conversion module, rev A), your packet states the items below without supporting records. Please send the evidence for each:

1. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program: procedure and recent audit records.
2. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) process: procedure and example records.
3. 1.calibration — calibration program covering production gauges: procedure and calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — current process failure-mode analysis (PFMEA) for this part.
5. 2.control_plan — control plan covering all three CTQs (output voltage, connector pitch, mounting-hole pitch).
6. 2.spc — SPC in use on the CTQs now: control charts and reaction plan.
7. 3.inspection_method — inspection method used for the CTQ tolerances, named (for example CMM) with the gauges used.
8. 5.lot_trace — lot or serial traceability to raw material: procedure and a sample trace record.
9. 5.nc_segregation — nonconforming material identification and segregation: procedure and records.
10. 8.flowdown — requirements flowed down to the sub-tier supplier: the flowdown document or purchase terms.

Thank you.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts
